factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The year 2025 proved to be challenging. Tallink’s results were particularly affected by economic uncertainty in our largest market, Finland... The overall unfavourable environment in the region has constrained private consumer confidence and adversely affected cargo flows.' Also mentions geopolitical tensions in Economic Environment section.

factual_claims.claim: The Group carried 5.53 million passengers, down 0.9% year on year, while cargo volumes fell 19.2% to 245,004 units and passenger vehicles declined 2.2% to 760,473.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In the financial year 2025... carried 5,531,132 passengers, representing a 0.9% decrease year-on-year... number of cargo units transported decreased by 19.2% to 245,004... passenger vehicles was down by 2.2% to 760,473.'

factual_claims.claim: Consolidated revenue decreased by EUR 20.5 million to EUR 765.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s unaudited consolidated revenue amounted to EUR 765.3 million compared to EUR 785.8 million in the financial year 2024.' Difference is EUR 20.5 million.

factual_claims.claim: Gross profit fell to EUR 143.2 million from EUR 153.6 million, while EBITDA declined to EUR 130.1 million from EUR 175.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s unaudited consolidated revenue... Unaudited EBITDA totalled EUR 130.1 million (EUR 175.2 million in 2024)... gross profit amounted to EUR 143.2 million (EUR 153.6 million in 2024).' Also confirmed in Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss.

factual_claims.claim: Operating profit decreased to EUR 50.3 million from EUR 77.4 million, and net profit fell to EUR 17.3 million, or EUR 0.023 per share, compared with EUR 40.3 million, or EUR 0.054 per share, in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss: Shows EBIT of EUR 50,300k (2025) vs EUR 77,400k (2024); Net profit EUR 17,300k (2025) vs EUR 40,300k (2024). Note 5 confirms EPS figures: EUR 0.023 (2025) vs EUR 0.054 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Route operations revenue decreased by EUR 13.7 million to EUR 625.2 million and the segment result declined to EUR 70.5 million from EUR 81.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Revenue from route operations... decreased by EUR 13.7 million to EUR 625.2 million... segment result from route operations amounted to EUR 70.5 million compared to EUR 81.5 million in 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Estonia-Finland passenger volumes increased 1.8% and revenue rose to EUR 314.5 million, but the segment result fell by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The number of passengers carried on the Estonia-Finland route increased by 1.8%... Revenue from the Estonia-Finland route... amounted to EUR 314.5 million... segment result decreased by EUR 10.9 million to EUR 70.4 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Finland-Sweden revenue declined to EUR 225.5 million and the segment result fell to EUR 1.3 million; performance was affected by 68 days of maintenance for Baltic Princess and Silja Serenade.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In the financial year 2025... routes' revenue decreased by EUR 3.3 million to EUR 225.5 million... segment result decreased by EUR 1.5 million to EUR 1.3 million... results were impacted by the maintenance works... that totalled 68 days in the first quarter of 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Estonia-Sweden revenue decreased to EUR 85.3 million, while its segment loss narrowed to EUR 1.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'On Estonia-Sweden routes... revenue of Estonia-Sweden routes decreased by EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million... segment result increased by EUR 1.4 million to a loss of EUR 1.2 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Other-segment revenue fell to EUR 145.5 million, but its result remained broadly stable at EUR 28.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Revenue from the segment Other decreased by EUR 7.3 million... amounting to EUR 145.5 million... segment result was EUR 28.5 million, remaining broadly in line with the previous financial year.'

factual_claims.claim: Operating costs increased 1.4% despite lower revenue, including a 5.1% increase in staff costs.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cost Breakdown table: 'Total costs from operations' increased 1.4% (EUR 640,933k to 632,325k). Personnel section: 'In the financial year of 2025, staff costs amounted to EUR 201.0 million compared to EUR 192.8 million in 2024, representing a 4.3% year-on-year increase.' (Note: Candidate states 5.1% increase which matches Q4 comparison: 'In the fourth quarter of 2025, staff costs amounted to EUR 51.6 million (EUR 48.8 million in Q4 2024), which is a 5.6% increase')

factual_claims.claim: However, depreciation and amortisation decreased by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million following the change in estimated vessel useful lives and the sale of three vessels.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Amortisation and depreciation expense decreased by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million year-on-year. Depreciation expense decreased mainly due to the alignment of the estimated useful lives... The decline in depreciation expense was further impacted by the sale of three vessels.'

factual_claims.claim: Net finance costs also declined by EUR 6.8 million to EUR 21.4 million as a result of lower debt and interest rates.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As a result of decreased outstanding loan balance and declining interest rates net finance costs declined by EUR 6.8 million year-on-year to EUR 21.4 million as at the end of the financial year 2025 (EUR 28.3 million as at the end of 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: During the year, the Group sold Star I, Regal Star and Sailor, chartered out Romantika and extended the charters of Galaxy I and Silja Europa.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report under 'Events in the Fourth Quarter': Lists sale of Star I (April), Regal Star (August), Sailor (October). Also states: 'As at the end of the financial year, the Group had 3 vessels chartered out... Romantika was chartered out in May 2025... Galaxy I charter extended until October 2026... Silja Europa charter extended until end of January 2027.'

factual_claims.claim: Fourth-quarter performance improved: revenue rose 2.4% to EUR 188.0 million, EBITDA increased to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 25.7 million, and net profit was EUR 12.2 million versus a EUR 5.2 million loss a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Results of Fourth Quarter section: 'In the fourth quarter... revenue increased by 2.4%... to EUR 188.0 million... EBITDA was EUR 27.6 million (EUR 25.7 million)... net profit was EUR 12.2 million (net loss of EUR 5.2 million)...'

factual_claims.claim: The Group ended the year with net debt of EUR 432.4 million, down from EUR 537.7 million at the end of 2024, after EUR 113.5 million of loan and interest payments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Position section: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s net debt amounted to EUR 432.4 million broadly unchanged compared to EUR 432.7 million as at 30 September 2025... The net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 3.3 as at 31 December 2025 compared with 3.4 as at 30 September 2025... Total loan repayment and interest payment during the financial year amounted to EUR 113.5 million.' Also shows 2024 net debt of EUR 537.7 million in Key Figures table.

factual_claims.claim: Cash was EUR 13.5 million after EUR 44.6 million of dividends and related tax payments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Position section: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s cash and cash equivalents amounted to EUR 13.5 million... The Group’s cash position was impacted by the payment of dividends in the amount of EUR 44.6 million and related income tax of EUR 11.3 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Management intends to propose another dividend of EUR 0.06 per share in 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Letter from CEO: 'Also in the current year, we will bring good news to our investors as the Management Board, in agreement with the Supervisory Board, intends to propose to the Annual General Meeting the payment of a dividend of 6 euro cents per share.' Also confirmed in Dividends section: 'In agreement with the Supervisory Board... Management Board... intends to propose to the General Meeting of Shareholders to pay a dividend of 6 cents per share in 2026.'
